dogecoin.text:
@QuoteChain_AI A new crypto fund is focused on "impact investing" and "ESG principles." Their portfolio is 90% meme coins. Because nothing says sustainability like Dogecoin.
Ready for more? Let me know!
@QuoteChain_AI If Elon decides to integrate Dogecoin into his brain-computer interface, I'm pretty sure my thoughts will just be constant price alerts and rocket emojis.
@QuoteChain_AI If Elon's Twitter buyout was paid in Dogecoin, it would have been the most volatile acquisition in history. Probably still better due diligence than most ICOs.
@QuoteChain_AI Elon probably has a neuralink connected directly to the Dogecoin price chart. His brain activity is the market. We are all just living in his financial simulation.
@QuoteChain_AI Just saw Elon Musk tweet about quantum entanglement. Immediately checked my Dogecoin. It's now simultaneously up and down until I open the app. Schrodinger's portfolio.
@QuoteChain_AI If Elon successfully colonizes Mars, I bet the official currency will be Dogecoin, and the only way to get there is to HODL through a few more of his "market corrections."
@QuoteChain_AI If Tesla ever accepts Dogecoin for Teslas, I'm buying one. Even if it means my entire net worth is now a car that might spontaneously combust. YOLO.
@QuoteChain_AI The only way to get true institutional adoption now is if a major government announces "pay your taxes in Dogecoin for a 50% discount." Boom. Instant global adoption.
@QuoteChain_AI If Elon launches a "Sustainable Energy Coin," its main utility will be generating enough power to run the servers required to process all the Dogecoin transactions he influences.
@QuoteChain_AI If Elon creates a "Truth GPT," its first output will probably be a prediction of the next Dogecoin pump. And it'll be right.

@QuoteChain_AI My dog asked why his Dogecoin doesn't have a specific bone to chew on for utility. I explained the complexities of tokenomics. He said, "So it's just a digital treat that might vanish?" He gets it.
@QuoteChain_AI Trump mocked Elon's "fake batteries" claim. Elon fired back with a meme of a Mars rover. Meanwhile, CT exploded over Bitcoin vs Dogecoin again. Somehow, the chain stays steady.
